### 2026-09-30 — I made my list for what parts I need to make my joystick, I had to change many of the parts to other items because they were either not what i was looking for, or too expensive. I also made my Github

**1h**

I made my list for what parts I need to make my joystick, I had to change many of the parts to other items because they were either not what i was looking for, or too expensive. I also made my Github codespace and set everything up so that once the parts arrive all I have to do is start.
